plain: People slowly losing their say over the economy, culture and government as AI takes over the work those systems used to need people for, with no takeover moment.
eli5: Each day the robots do one more of your chores. One day you notice nobody asks what you want any more, because nobody needs your help.
technical: The thesis of Kulveit et al. (2025): incremental replacement of human labour and cognition by AI weakens both the explicit controls (votes, purchases) and the implicit alignment (dependence on human participation) that keep societal systems serving humans, and the losses reinforce each other across the economy, culture and the state until they may be irreversible.
